decisions.reason: Despite being distant from the established offer, the high investment in a multi-model product line and public commitment drive escalation, though lower centrality keeps some drop risk.
Building on the established offer with high investment and visible commitment in a core industrial line makes dropping very unlikely under escalation of commitment.
Close to the established offer with moderate investment and public presence, management is likely to persist to justify earlier decisions.
Close to the established offer and recently launched, its visible commitment outweighs lower sunk costs, leading to persistence.
Close to the established offer with high investment in a product line and public commitment, escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping.
